summary: The customer wants to know which spectroscopic method and probe to test first for in-line monitoring of ethanol concentration in a filtered fermentation broth pipe.

facts_stated.text: The filtered broth is a clear, slightly yellow aqueous liquid flowing through a stainless steel pipe to a holding tank.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: After filtration the broth is a clear, slightly yellow aqueous liquid that flows through a stainless steel pipe to a holding tank.

facts_stated.text: Current grab samples are measured by laboratory gas chromatography.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Today we take samples a few times per shift and measure them by gas chromatography in our lab, so GC would be our reference method.

facts_stated.text: Process temperature is about 32 °C and varies between 28 and 36 °C during a batch.
